clue.text: Obliged to cut fish

parts.note: obliged, as in 'had to go', gives had
to dock a tail is to cut it short

explanation.surface: Someone forced to trim a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The haddock is a North Atlantic food fish of the cod family.

clue.text: Henry has one although it's flatfish

parts.note: Hal is the familiar short form of Henry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal
the Roman numeral for one is I
but can mean although, as in 'poor but honest'

explanation.surface: Henry owns a fish, even though it is a flat one.
explanation.definitionFit: The halibut is a very large flatfish of northern seas, an example of the category.

clue.text: Rough water fled from Dutch pottery

indicators.note: rough water is churned up, so these letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: Choppy seas drove people away from a Dutch pottery town.
explanation.definitionFit: Delftware is the blue-and-white tin-glazed earthenware made in Delft in the Netherlands.

clue.text: Poem about cinema?

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem
on means about, as in 'a book on birds'

explanation.surface: A verse written about a picture house.
explanation.definitionFit: Odeon is the name of a chain of British cinemas, so it stands for a cinema, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Get engine going for thrills with loose woman

parts.note: kicks are thrills, as in 'doing it for kicks'
tart is a slang term for a promiscuous woman

explanation.surface: Someone starts a motorbike for excitement with a racy companion.
explanation.definitionFit: To kick-start is to start a motorcycle engine by pushing down a pedal with the foot.

clue.text: Crustacean? Throw rest off

parts.note: to lob is to throw something in a high arc

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters of rest are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a shellfish is in question, then telling someone to throw the rest away.
explanation.definitionFit: A lobster is a large marine crustacean with claws.

clue.text: Fibs about end of plum (fruit)

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so lies goes round the other piece

parts.note: fibs are lies

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of plum

explanation.surface: Lies are told about the last of the plums.
explanation.definitionFit: Limes are small green citrus fruits.

clue.text: Proceed unsteadily with insect — a big hairy one

parts.note: to bumble is to move or act in a clumsy, unsteady way
a bee is an insect

explanation.surface: A big hairy creature wobbling along through the air.
explanation.definitionFit: The bumblebee is a large, furry bee, so it is a big hairy example of an insect.

clue.text: Some heat for the commandos

parts.note: the Royal Marines, abbreviated RM, are the British commando force

explanation.surface: A bit of warmth for the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A therm is a unit of heat used for measuring gas supply, so it is a quantity of heat.

clue.text: Train engineers to untie rigging

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

indicators.note: rigging means fixing or tampering with, so the letters of untie are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for engineers on untying a ship's ropes.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue is the train of attendants following an important person, a sense of train.

clue.text: Not well in the French port

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: le is French for the
ill means not well

explanation.surface: Feeling sick in a French harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Lille is a city in northern France with a river port on the Deûle canal.

clue.text: Cheese arrived with decoration, right?

parts.note: came means arrived
the MBE is a British honour, Member of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a cheese turned up with a medal attached.
explanation.definitionFit: Camembert is a soft, creamy French cheese from Normandy.

clue.text: People sure to find bloomers in their work

definitions.text: People sure to find bloomers in their work

parts.words: People sure to find bloomers in their work
parts.note: bloomers suggests blunders or underwear, but here means flowering plants, which plant scientists study

explanation.surface: Workers who are bound to make embarrassing mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanists are scientists who study plants, including flowering ones that bloom.

clue.text: Fruit from the French on Monday

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit bought from French sellers at the start of the week.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon is a yellow citrus fruit.

clue.text: Drink to soldiers perhaps

definitions.meaning: to drink to someone is to raise a glass in their honour
in Britain, soldiers are fingers of grilled bread for dipping into a boiled egg

explanation.surface: Raising a glass to the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A toast is a drink in someone's honour, and also grilled bread, of which soldiers are strips.

clue.text: The American women found in eastern England

parts.note: taken as written
broads is American slang for women

explanation.surface: American ladies turning up on holiday in East Anglia.
explanation.walkthrough: The Broads are a network of rivers and lakes in Norfolk and Suffolk, eastern England, popular for boating.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norfolk Broads are a well-known waterway region of eastern England, so they stand for a part of it.

clue.text: Outline a stupid charge

parts.note: dumb means stupid
a rate is a charge or price

explanation.surface: Describing in brief a foolish accusation.
explanation.definitionFit: To adumbrate is to give a sketchy outline or faint indication of something.

clue.text: Lightly cooked, less than Dutch one

parts.note: under means less than, as in 'under ten pounds'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A meal barely cooked, compared with a Dutch one.
explanation.definitionFit: Underdone food has been cooked too little, lightly rather than thoroughly.

clue.text: Current strength illuminated due strangely to breadth

parts.note: the amp is the unit of electric current strength
lit means illuminated

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of due are arranged oddly

explanation.surface: An electrical reading, lit up and oddly broad.
explanation.definitionFit: Amplitude means breadth or width, the extent or largeness of something.

clue.text: Gave gift to Edward

parts.note: a present is a gift
Ed is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: Someone handed a gift to a man called Edward.
explanation.definitionFit: Presented means gave formally, as in presented a prize.

clue.text: Fatter for every fruit put on top

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting one piece on top places it before the other

parts.note: a plum is a fruit
per means for every, as in 'two per person'

explanation.surface: Each piece of fruit placed on top makes someone heavier.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumper means more rounded or chubby, a comparative synonym of fatter.

clue.text: Get rid of former partner — left after exercise

indicators.note: after places the letter for left behind the exercise piece

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
PE is physical education, exercise at school

explanation.surface: Dumping an ex who walked out after a gym session.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to drive out or get rid of someone, especially from a school.

clue.text: Take some weight off and shine

definitions.meaning: to make a load less heavy
to grow brighter or give light

explanation.definitionFit: Lighten means both to reduce in weight and to brighten or become lighter.

clue.text: Colour of the cockney's river

indicators.note: Londoners of the cockney dialect drop their aitches, so the opening H goes

parts.note: the Humber is a river estuary in northeast England

explanation.surface: Asking about the shade of a Londoner's local river.
explanation.definitionFit: Umber is a natural brown earth pigment and the dark brown colour it gives.

clue.text: Reason female relative follows graduate

indicators.note: follows places the relative after the graduate

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate
sis is short for sister

explanation.surface: A sister coming after her graduate sibling for good reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A basis is the grounds or reason for something, as in 'on what basis?'

clue.text: Extraordinary police activity

explanation.definitionFit: Arresting means striking or remarkable, and it is also the police act of detaining suspects.

clue.text: A female beginning to stake trees

parts.note: she is the female pronoun

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of stake

explanation.surface: A woman starts staking young trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashes is the plural of ash, a common deciduous tree.

clue.text: Footware items are hits

definitions.meaning: garments worn on the feet inside shoes

explanation.definitionFit: Socks are knitted foot coverings, and socks as a verb means hits or punches.

clue.text: Is a chip to replace a nut?

indicators.note: replace means place again differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a chip could stand in for a nut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' belongs to the fodder: IS A CHIP TO has the nine letters, and 'replace' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The pistachio is a green-kernelled edible nut.

clue.text: Include a nobleman

definitions.meaning: a European aristocrat equal in rank to an earl

explanation.definitionFit: To count is to include, and a count is a continental nobleman.

clue.text: Doesn't give in — sisters upset

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters of sisters are disordered

explanation.surface: Someone stands firm when siblings are distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Resists means holds out against or refuses to yield.

clue.text: Oriental plant found between Egypt and Nepal initially

indicators.note: found between places the plant inside the two initials
initially picks the first letter of each place name

parts.note: the aster is a daisy-like garden plant

explanation.surface: An Asian flower discovered on a route from Egypt to Nepal.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental and eastern both mean relating to the East, especially Asia.
